const V11_FPS=8; // real SpriteCollab sprites embedded offline
// Crop the transparent border of each sprite frame; this stabilizes apparent size across
// Idle, Walk, Attack and Hurt even when source files use different frame dimensions.
const V19_FRAME_CACHE=new WeakMap();
function v19FrameBounds(pic,sx,sy,sw,sh){
  let byImage=V19_FRAME_CACHE.get(pic);if(!byImage){byImage=new Map();V19_FRAME_CACHE.set(pic,byImage)}
  const key=`${sx}:${sy}:${sw}:${sh}`;if(byImage.has(key))return byImage.get(key);
  let bounds={x:sx,y:sy,w:sw,h:sh};
  try{
    const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=sw;canvas.height=sh;
    const c=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
    c.drawImage(pic,sx,sy,sw,sh,0,0,sw,sh);
    const rgba=c.getImageData(0,0,sw,sh).data;let left=sw,right=-1,top=sh,bottom=-1;
    for(let y=0;y<sh;y++)for(let x=0;x<sw;x++)if(rgba[(y*sw+x)*4+3]>28){
       if(x<left)left=x;if(x>right)right=x;if(y<top)top=y;if(y>bottom)bottom=y;
    }
    if(right>=left&&bottom>=top)bounds={x:sx+left,y:sy+top,w:right-left+1,h:bottom-top+1};
  }catch(err){} // if image is cross-origin or canvas unavailable, retain original crop
  byImage.set(key,bounds);return bounds;
